description.narrative: This project aims to create a nurturing and empowering environment for women and adolescent girls in central Bekaa, focusing on building critical skills in English and IT over a six-month period in 2025. The primary objective is to enhance their employability and educational opportunities through targeted training sessions designed to meet the evolving demands of the job market. Participants will receive comprehensive English language training to improve communication skills, enabling them to pursue diverse professional and educational opportunities. Simultaneously, International Computer Driving License (ICDL) training will equip them with essential digital literacy skills, such as proficiency in common software applications and online tools, significantly increasing their competitiveness in the workforce, including opportunities for remote and freelance work. Also, participants of the project will be targeted by awareness sessions and individual PSS through protection in the same safe space in Chtaura,helping participants manage stress and build self-confidence. Networking opportunities will also play a central role, connecting women and girls with shared interests, experiences, and ambitions, creating a supportive community that strengthens social ties and promotes collaboration. Additionally, the empowerment activities and participants will be linked to case management services to address vulnerabilities, such as those related to gender-based violence, ensuring a holistic approach to their empowerment.
